description: We are Water Detectives from Hosur, India. I am a 12-year-old student who builds electronics and Python projects. I have made a CanSat-style satellite with a Raspberry Pi Pico and sensors, and I am building a hand-held water tester with an ESP32 that checks TDS, pH, turbidity and temperature. For Space Apps I want to use NASA Earth data to spot water and climate trends. Skills: Python, ESP32, sensors, 3D design in Tinkercad. This is a family team and we are not looking for new members.
